baseline: phase3 own-inner-selected condition/cap, seed2027, original frozen decoder; reuse emissions
warm_start: same original checkpoint for control/BCE/focal; new AdamW for eight-epoch bounded finetuning on five IDSSE training matches
selection: own inner match only; epoch maximizes weighted frozen-decoder spellF1; ties earliest. Loss and adaptive strength chosen on own inner match with robustness and long-spell recall guards. Zero strength always admissible.
pilot_policy: canonical folds 0 and 6, validation only. Both small predeclared loss families remain candidates on remaining folds; no cross-fold hyperparameter transfer from a model exposed to another fold test.
test_policy: freeze every fold selection before ANY phase5 test evaluation; outer results descriptive on previously observed IDSSE cohort
ensemble: deferred: no retrospective promotion of the test-best three-seed pipeline; primary factorial uses one identical seed
native_25hz: boundary targets derived from native transitions, not interpolated labels; optional new feature branch deferred because measured 10Hz label oracle is approximately 0.995
